method: Original face-evidence tags preserved through Boolean operations; per-face material colors, no textures.

rules.name: Unobserved closure and manufacture
rules.note: Rear surfaces and lower ground-contact are neutral plan-constrained approximations, not observed blank walls. Solid interior and display plinth are manufactured.

rules.name: Distinct lower plans and 3F front projection
rules.note: Lower sheets separately traced. Exposed display heights are photographic choices, not floor-to-floor measurements. No B1 reconstruction.

rules.name: Whole high hall and paired front corners
rules.note: Front and side organization retained; total exterior height unverified.

rules.name: Colonnade, recessed glass and overhanging fascia
rules.note: Six tall columns; recessed field, not a flat painted facade. Fine cladding seams omitted.

rules.name: Front glass corner volumes
rules.note: Opaque blue-green model interpretation; no image textures or literal reflections.

rules.name: Opposite flank bands
rules.note: Independently parameterized band heights and lower window positions; not a mirror operation.

rules.name: Sculpture-side flank bands
rules.note: Sculpture excluded. Distinct low wall, canopy, glazing and circulation tower.

rules.name: Rear lateral stair tower masses
rules.note: Visible lateral and front-facing glazing only. Rear surfaces neutral; stair internals not reconstructed.

rules.name: 4F terrace and asymmetric exterior stair system
rules.note: Separate traced upper terrace, long right flights, left front/rear flights and front access. Tread counts and rail forms simplified.

rules.name: Installed PV representative roof
rules.note: Coarse low arrays with blue access gaps. Not exposed five-strip pre-solar roof; no exact module count, tilt, equipment or electrical design.
